findings.finding: The Q3 bar asks for an acceleration that the best-informed house does not forecast: consensus adj. EBIT 19.1 MEUR (range 18.1-20.0) needs +2.0m y/y on Q3'25's 17.1m, against Q2's +0.8m, and Inderes, the closest follower of the name, is at 18 MEUR, below consensus. Its sales estimate (356) is above consensus (352), so the gap is margin: a full quarter of the April 2026 digital-government-mail law hitting letters, and a still loss-making warehousing segment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Observed print days (Yahoo closes): Q3'25 -4.6% (2025-10-29), Q4'25 +7.9% (2026-02-13), Q1'26 -2.3% on a miss (2026-04-29), Q2'26 +7.4% on a beat vs Inderes and consensus (2026-08-14). The stock has followed the sign of the EBIT surprise each time.
findings.original_quote: Odotamme Postin Q3:n oikaistun liikevoiton nousseen 18 MEUR:oon (Q3'25: 17 MEUR), mikä vastaa 5,1 %:n marginaalia. Konsensus odottaa 19 MEUR:n tulosta. (We expect Posti's Q3 adjusted EBIT to have risen to 18 MEUR, a 5.1% margin. Consensus expects 19 MEUR.)
findings.why_not_priced: Thin coverage (4 analysts, $0.59m/day). The preview sits behind Inderes' Finnish page and forum, and the consensus figure lives on Vara's page. If the market were leaning toward a miss, the stock would not be trading at the consensus target price (12.88 vs spot ~12.94) after +27% in 60 days. But this rests on one house's estimate, not a company number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Vara consensus table (https://vara-services.com/posti-group/consensus-estimates/?cluster=1) supplies the 19.1 mean and the 18.1 low, which is probably Inderes; same underlying estimates, so not independent evidence of a miss.

findings.finding: Sell-side valuation ceiling: Nordea Markets refreshed Posti on 2026-10-19 at Hold with a EUR 12 target, the TP consensus fell to 12.88 from 13.07, and the stock at 12.94-13.02 trades at or above every target except Danske's 13.5. So an in-line print has little valuation room after the stock rose from 8.25 (Feb) to ~13.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed case on this name of a print reacting to target-price saturation. The two beats (Feb, Aug 2026) rose 7-8% while the stock was trading well below the targets of the time.
findings.why_not_priced: Public data, mostly priced; the fact that the stock already trades at the targets is itself the market's statement. It is filed because it affects how an in-line or slight-miss print is received, and sized small as an inference about the reaction.
findings.independence: Inderes' own target of 13.0 is at spot (forum post #270, https://forum.inderes.com/t/67588/270)

findings.finding: Second change negotiations in six months (announced August 2026: 637 workers in Helsinki sorting and day delivery, up to ~50 roles) triggered a walkout at the Pasila postal centre on 19-20 Aug that delayed letters and small parcels for about two days. The likely Q3 effect is restructuring special items below adj. EBIT plus a minor operational cost.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Special items have been excluded from the bar every quarter (Q2'26 2.8m, Q3'25 5.1m), with no visible reaction to them.
findings.original_quote: Muutosneuvottelut koskevat Helsingin postikeskuksen lajittelua sekä päiväjakelua eri puolilla Suomea. Neuvottelujen piirissä on yhteensä 637 postityöntekijää. (The change negotiations concern sorting at the Helsinki postal centre and day delivery across Finland; 637 postal workers are covered.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is small, below adj. EBIT, and was also reported in English (Yle News). Filed as a sourced fact bearing on the quarter, sized near 0.
